ai_summary: Apex Frozen Foods Limited has announced September 10, 2026, as the record date for its proposed final dividend of Rs. 2.50 per equity share (25% of paid-up value) for the Financial Year 2025-26, signaling a commitment to shareholder returns. This dividend is contingent on shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting, with payment, if declared, scheduled on or before October 16, 2026; no material red flags are present in this routine regulatory filing.
